statement: Functional evidence only. Hosted behaviour was not exercised: no hosted VM, SSH, workflow dispatch, broker sandbox, futures smoke, live order, real capital or model provider call was run. Hosted verification belongs to INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

acceptance.1: runtime_summary folds fills per position key (symbol for a cash share, instrument_id for a stock future) with multiplier-scaled realized and unrealized PnL, exposes positions with instrument_id/kind/multiplier/contract_month/margin_reserved/currency plus positions_by_underlying, and folds paper_futures_settled idempotently. Tests replay the real cash share fill (2330.TWSE -5 @ 2299, mark 2240 -> unrealized 295, market value -11200) and a stock-future fill shape (2 contracts @ 2300 x100, sell 1 @ 2350 -> realized 5000; mark 2360 -> market value 236000, unrealized 6000).
acceptance.2: trade_episode_projection carries instrument_id (future contract), underlying_symbol, instrument_kind, multiplier, contract_month and reason_code only when events report them; futures fee+tax is counted as fees; a gate rejection that opens an episode reads rejected. Schema extended with optional fields. feedback_adapter order_context carries instrument_id, kind, multiplier, contract_month, reason_code, fee, tax, initial_margin_reserved. Cash share episodes are unchanged (asserted).
acceptance.3: pm12 holdings: market_value = quantity x multiplier x mark_price; instrument_id, instrument_kind, contract_month, multiplier, margin_reserved added; holding_id no longer collides between a future and its underlying cash row; stale/unavailable mark now clears unrealized_pnl with mark_price and market_value. BFF_API_CONTRACT.md documents the fields. Test uses the real RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore position shape through the holdings endpoint.
acceptance.4: agora performance facts value positions with the multiplier and expose summary.instrument_breakdown grouped by instrument (supported_dimensions unchanged). decision projection subject.asset_class follows the chosen instrument kind (cash_share->equity, stock_future->future; unknown kind rejected).
acceptance.5: reconciliation-drift fill identity includes instrument_id (optional, legacy fills key on empty); order_rejection, paper_order_simulated no trade, paper_futures_settled, paper_margin_call and paper_forced_liquidation with zero/absent fill quantity no longer yield ambiguous_fill_evidence or duplicate findings. Test: a day with one fill, one rejection and one no trade is measured/ok; a non-fill event that reports a fill stays ambiguous; cash+future fills for one decision are not duplicates; two orders for one instrument still report a duplicate.
acceptance.6: scripts/probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py and services/trade_journey/hosted_lifecycle_probe.py and hosted_lifecycle_stimulus.py accept risk-gate order_rejection (closed reason set, non-gate reasons such as broker errors still fail closed), recorded paper_order_simulated no trade, and paper_futures_settled as terminals. Persona validation (agent_usability_validation, remaining_gap_validation) accepts signed fill quantities and gate-rejection/no-trade terminals. Each has tests. Persona-validation tests live in scripts/test_probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py; the LEAN base and feedback-adapter instrument tests live in services/telemetry/test_paper_runtime_ingest_contract.py (contract-declared files).
acceptance.7: integrations/lean/pantheon_algo/base.py OnOrderEvent carries optional instrument_id/multiplier/kind/contract_month defensively; test proves a fill with instrument_id and multiplier is processed and malformed values are skipped.
acceptance.8: No existing assertion was weakened or edited; every change to an existing test file is an appended test. Every changed file is inside the declared artifact contract (no new test file was created, so bff_test_architecture_inventory.json needed no new entry and test_bff_test_architecture.py passes). The shared closed set of risk-gate rejection reasons lives in hosted_lifecycle_probe.py and is held equal in scripts/probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py and both persona validation modules by a parity test.

commands.result: 500 passed, 1 skipped, 54 subtests passed on the pre-merge head; after the dev merge and test relocation the touched modules were re-run: test_paper_runtime_ingest_contract + test_feedback_adapter + test_discovery_imports 79 passed
321 passed, 1 skipped (final head, after test relocation)

591 passed, 82 skipped, 1 failed on the pre-relocation head: services/trade_journey/test_lifecycle_projector_compose.py::test_rendered_compose_operator_bff_readiness_with_postgres_reader needs a Postgres DSN ('Postgres DSN is required'); it is environment-dependent and unrelated to this change, and was not run green here.

not_verified: tests/e2e/test_persona_remaining_gap_validation_3000.py fails in this worktree before and independent of this change (signals are discarded for a missing runtime_id by the evolved signal consumer, so 'No paper_fill_simulated event'); persona validation changes are covered by services/persona/test_paper_terminal_acceptance.py instead.

A real risk-gate order_rejection from paper_runtime was not driven through the persona validation drain: the Taiwan path needs an admitted market price. Gate rejection shapes in tests are taken from paper_runtime's published metrics/metadata.
Futures marks in runtime_summary are matched by instrument_id mark_refs; the producer-side emission of instrument-keyed mark_refs was not changed or verified here.
Hosted behaviour of every surface above.
notes: Environment: tests ran with another worktree's .venv-pantheon interpreter because this worktree has none.
The branch was refreshed by merging origin/dev (no conflicts) after the first handoff attempt was rejected for a moved base.
